items.title: Abbey Lincoln — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Leon Baker, one of the singers with the company, and I wrote this lyric

ctx.x: You had also recorded before "Freedom Now Suite" with Max.

Yes, the first album that I did with him was called "That's Him." He's the one who was A&R man, really. I made three albums for Riverside. He brought me to the jazz community, and then after "It's Magic," I think -- well, we had been performing the "Freedom Now Suite." We hadn't recorded it yet, and we were getting a reputation for being loony. They said we were both crazy. I had written a lyric called "In the Red". "No account, bank account, can't raise a dime, can't pay the bills I got on time," and Roach set…
